scope: Source-pose mold for every mob species/variant animation. Slot structure mirrors art-reference/players/equipment-v1/body/; action frame counts follow the mob runtime (productionContract: east/west x4) because arena-art-pixel-v2 sheets consume 4 frames per action direction. Mob poses are weapon-baked, never clean-body.
bakedRule: Every pose PNG includes the species body plus its signature weapon or natural weapon in the same pixels. No separate weapon PNGs, no grip/pivot estimates, no runtime weapon rotation. Mobs have no equipment and no equip switch: one fixed baked weapon per species/variant.
camera: Elevated fixed three-quarter game camera, upper-left light. Crisp native pixel-art clusters and hard opaque edges, no antialias painterly blur. One pose per PNG, whole sprite including feet contained, transparent background, no grid/checkerboard, text, labels, borders, scenery, VFX or ground shadow.

reference.shows: Species identity plus signature weapon in south-east idle pose. Counterpart of body/reference.png; unlike the player reference, hands are never empty.

walk.naming: walk/<direction>/00-stride-a.png, 01-stride-b.png, 02-stride-c.png, 03-stride-d.png (one full stride cycle, feet return to start)
walk.parity: Movement reads as well as the player walk at play size: same three-quarter facing convention, stable root anchor across all 4 frames, species gait only changes limbs/posture, never camera, scale or anchor.

attack.attackKind: Declared per species in its meta (close | far). Default follows the species line from tools/data/engine.json: front -> close, stand-off -> far. Override only with recorded evidence.

close.motion: Melee delivery (cast range basis body-edge): lunge toward facing, weapon or natural weapon makes contact at body edge, weight committed forward, feet stay inside the cell.

far.motion: Projectile delivery (cast range basis center, ~5.2 m at 12 mps): feet planted, body extends toward facing without lunging; the projectile leaves from the declared releaseSocket on the 01-release frame, never from the body center.

attack.note: Basic swing lives directly under attack/ in the species attackKind. One extra profile per mob-skills.json kit entry with a cast block lives under skill/<action-slug>/ in that entry's delivery kind (melee/projectile/ground-downward-strike); kit entries without a cast block get no folder.

skill.per: Each mob-skills.json kit entry the species/variant resolves gets skill/<action-slug>/{east,west}.png, baked exactly like body/skill/shield-bash/. No kit entry, no skill folder.
skill.slug: Last segment of the skill id (mob.physical.backstab -> backstab).
skill.note: Skill profiles reuse the attack-kind phase names above (far profiles carry releaseSocket on 01-release like the basic far attack).

animation.timingSource: game/src/ui/combat/arena/arena-art-pixel-v2.ts pilotArt sheets; presentation only, gameplay timing stays authoritative
rules: Every frame is a real pose change, never a translated copy or duplicate (QA fails identical opaque content).
Contact reads at a glance: weapon at full extension, weight committed, silhouette maximally different from windup; attack contact and hit must survive a single-glance read at play size.
Windup compresses opposite the contact direction so anticipation reads before the strike.
Walk loops seamlessly: frame 03 flows back into frame 00 with the root anchor stable and feet returning to start.
Feet stay planted in idle/walk/attack/hit within a 24 px ground line (QA gated, death exempt); only death goes low, and stays inside its cell.
Idle keeps one shared ground line and breathes without travelling; anchor never drifts between facings.

nonScope: No equipment production for mobs beyond the baked weapon already in each pose: no per-weapon-type equipment sets, no side/raised/foreshortened/ready/drawn/released weapon views, no shield or stowed views, no grip/socket metadata, no equipment JSON manifests. The bakedWeapon id string in each slot meta is the entire weapon scope.
perSlotMetaFields: releaseSocket (required on far-attack 01-release frames: x/y source pixels, provenance measured)
bakedWeapon (species weapon/natural-weapon ids visible in these pixels)
assembly: Per-pose PNGs assemble into the species animation/{atlas/,meta.json}: 40 pose cells (idle 8 + walk/attack/hit/death east/west x4) plus the identity reference, following the minotaur rowOrder convention. Art versions never change skill/save identity.
reject: clean body with empty hands (player pipeline mold, not mob)
separate weapon PNG or grip/pivot estimate instead of baked pixels
shared body across species or variants (silhouette and personality differ per species)
missing direction or phase versus this mold
attack kind contradicting the species line without a recorded override
far attacker without a measured releaseSocket on the release frame
duplicate or translated-copy frames (identical opaque content across frames)
upright ground line drifting more than 24 px
VFX, ground shadow, scenery or text baked into a pose
